name.text: 26.1 Circle Theorems - intersecting chord, same segment, semicircle

questiontext.text:
A, B, C and D are points on a circle, centre O.

AOD is a diameter of the circle.

Angle CBD = {@aa@}°

Angle BDA = {@bb@}°


Find Angle DAC

Angle DAC = [[input:ans1]]° [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

Find Angle CDB

Angle CDB = [[input:ans2]]° [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]



The chords DE and BC intersect at the point F



The length EF = {@gg@}cm

The length CF = {@gg+1@}cm

The length DF = {@2*gg@}cm

Find the length BF

BF = [[input:ans3]]cm[[validation:ans3]][[feedback:prt3]]

questionvariables.text:
aa:rand(9)+20 bb:rand(5)+30 cc:90-aa-bb dd:rand(2)+6 ee:dd*(dd-1)/(dd-2)
gg:rand([3,4, 7,9, 19]) response3:2*gg*gg/(gg+1)
